of.needed: whether any UpdateRequest objects exist in the cluster stored as v1beta1 (Kyverno creates UpdateRequests at runtime for mutate/generate policies, so stored-object state is not visible in manifests)

original.statement: The storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD changed from v1beta1 to v2 (v1beta1.storage true→false, v2.storage false→true between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0), so existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update is required before a later release removes v1beta1.

corrected.statement: An environment is exposed when the status.storedVersions of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD still lists v1beta1. Its stored UpdateRequest objects must then be rewritten to v2 and storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: [ev-cf5b10ff8047] and [ev-d3850c78b94e] show that the storage flag of updaterequests.kyverno.io moves from v1beta1 to v2 between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0. The change text says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 and that status.storedVersions must be updated. That state can be read from the CRD's status.storedVersions, so an undecidable leaf is not allowed here. The edge-from-version conjunct is also too narrow: a cluster already running 1.13.x still needs the migration if storedVersions still lists v1beta1. The correct condition is the canonical CRD stored-version migration shape.
